metadata.title: Rustic Adventure Illustration with Isometric Typography
useCases: Folk or Country Music Album Covers

retrievalProfile.description: A painterly wilderness scene featuring a rustic cabin and figures, dominated by massive, isometric 3D block lettering that appears to float in the sky.
excludeWhen: clean vector flat design is requested
urban or futuristic settings are needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A nostalgic, hand-painted landscape depicting two figures in dense brush pointing toward a secluded log cabin by a river, topped with heavy, architectural 3D typography that follows a forced isometric perspective.
coreVisualRelationships: The massive 3D text acts as a physical ceiling over the landscape.
The figures in the foreground create a diagonal line of sight toward the cabin.
The river provides a horizontal counter-balance to the verticality of the trees and cabin chimney.
coreInvariants: Isometric extrusion of text toward the top right
Painterly, visible brushstrokes in the foliage
Warm, low-angle lighting suggesting late afternoon

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Figures occupy the bottom right foreground; the cabin is the mid-ground focal point on the left; typography dominates the top third.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, black-faced 3D lettering in the upper half of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the heavy text, follows the pointing arm of the figure down to the cabin, then traces the river back to the foreground.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with foliage, water, and large-scale graphic elements.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Earthy browns and terracotta (cabin and text extrusion)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pale blue and white (river and sky)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the black text faces and the light sky; muted, naturalistic saturation for the landscape.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to earth tones and sky blues

letterConstructionRules: Massive 3D extrusion following a consistent isometric angle
Black face with thin gold or light-colored inner stroke
Extrusion sides show wood-like texture or terracotta color with hatching
Text follows a slight upward arc or stepped arrangement
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are tightly kerned to create a solid architectural block
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single heavy display face with varying scales and extrusion depths.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and geometric simplicity for 3D extrusion.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a gouache-style painting of a lush green wilderness with a small log cabin on the left bank of a winding river. Include two people in the foreground brush, one pointing toward the cabin. Use a warm sunset sky.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, isometric 3D block text in the sky area. The text should have black faces, thin light outlines, and thick terracotta-colored extruded sides with fine line hatching for shadow.

verificationChecks: Is the text extrusion consistent in angle?
Does the landscape have a hand-painted, non-digital texture?
Is the pointing gesture clearly directed at the cabin?

adjustableVariables: Number of figures in the foreground
mustRedesign: Avoid modern digital gradients in the text
Ensure the cabin looks hand-built and rustic
Maintain the 'floating block' feel of the typography
postGenerationChecks: Check that the 3D text doesn't obscure the cabin focal point.
Ensure the hatching on the text sides matches the landscape's lighting direction.
Verify the figures' clothing looks appropriate for a rustic setting.
Confirm the river has reflective qualities consistent with gouache techniques.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [painterly wilderness landscape] with [massive isometric 3D block lettering] in a [1970s illustration style] using [earthy gouache palette].
